question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Futile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Useless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"futile"** means something that is incapable of producing any useful result; pointless. (व्यर्थ)

 
 
• **Example: **His efforts to convince her were futile as she had already made up her mind.
 
 
 
• **"Useless" **refers to something that is not useful or effective; having no practical use or value. (बेकार)
 
 
• **Example: **Trying to fix the broken vase with glue was a useless endeavor.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'futile' **is **'useless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Useless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vicious **(दुष्ट): Deliberately cruel or violent.

 
 
• **Example:** The dog was vicious and attacked anyone who came near.
 
 
 
• **Adequate **(पर्याप्त): Satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity.
 
 
• **Example: **He provided an adequate amount of food for the guests.
 
 
 
• **Thoughtful** (विचारशील): Showing consideration for the needs of other people.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very thoughtful and always remembered everyone's birthdays.
